title: PartKept
description: part_kept (since 1.5): the server kept a part in the state the node asked for with a part frame that had an id (the ref of this frame).

told.description: True when her reaction is still to come (a turn with the cause part_switched follows): a node that shows the change with her reaction waits for it. False when she was told already (she decided on it) or is not told at all: show it at once.
